Concrete fix: for each of the eight descriptions, decode the current value exactly once—remove the accidental opening/closing quote characters and trailing accidental newline, and replace each literal two-character `\n` sequence with an actual line feed. Preserve the inner revised wording. The result must begin as ordinary prose and contain real lines such as:

```markdown

...

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: ...
```

All twelve task titles are otherwise clean, and all carry the valid `epic:jit-profiles` and `milestone:v1.0` membership slugs.

The four implementation roots modify existing crates and repository infrastructure; none requires a directory or skeleton created by another task. No missing prerequisite or false serialization was found.

## Structural integrity

The bracket spine is intact: planning node `ca024a2b` feeds breakdown node `96326159`, which feeds the implementation graph, whose final leaf `bcff56be` feeds container `9b7b5f9c`. No created issue is isolated.

The flat task tier is explicitly justified in the design: every item is intended to leave the repository green and independently reviewable, while capability groups are not containers ([line 42](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/.agents/worktrees/agent-9b7b5f9c/dev/active/9b7b5f9c-plan.md:42)). Decision D11 further assigns exclusive seams to twelve transitively reduced leaves and rejects a catch-all task ([line 197](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/.agents/worktrees/agent-9b7b5f9c/dev/active/9b7b5f9c-plan.md:197)). The instantiated scopes preserve that ownership.
